projects.title: Worker / Console
projects.serilogShape: Log.* + Console/File sinks + appsettings.json via ReadFrom.Configuration
projects.notes: Config-driven app. Not zero-source-change-eligible (no Layer-2 ReadFrom.Configuration bridge). Find-replace is the realistic vehicle. Program.cs: using Serilog -> using MMP.Herald.Serilog, plus an ADDED using Herald.OSS.Serilog.Settings (ReadFrom.Configuration lives there). csproj swaps Serilog* sink packages for MMP.Herald.Serilog + Herald.OSS.Serilog.Settings. Output is semantically identical at the level/message layer, but the rendered FORMAT differs (console template, UTC/ISO timestamp, numeric level suffix, DateTimeOffset culture) — log-scraping regexes tuned to Serilog's default text format would need updating.
gotchas: ReadFrom.Configuration requires an ADDED 'using Herald.OSS.Serilog.Settings;' — it is NOT a single-line namespace swap for config-driven apps. The extension hangs off the Herald.OSS.Serilog.Settings namespace, not Serilog/MMP.Herald.Serilog.

projects.title: ASP.NET Core Minimal API
projects.notes: ASP.NET case. UseSerilog and UseSerilogRequestLogging carry over (extensions sit in the framework namespaces the app already imports). Request-logging middleware fires (verified: 'HTTP GET / responded 200'). Two small parity adjustments required: CreateBootstrapLogger() -> CreateLogger(); CloseAndFlushAsync() -> CloseAndFlush(). Plus the same added using Herald.OSS.Serilog.Settings for ReadFrom.Configuration.
gotchas: LoggerConfiguration.CreateBootstrapLogger() is not in the Herald surface. Use CreateLogger().
Log.CloseAndFlushAsync() is not in the Herald surface. Use the sync CloseAndFlush().
ReadFrom.Configuration needs the added using Herald.OSS.Serilog.Settings; (same as Ref1).

projects.notes: FLAGSHIP zero-source-change result. Program.cs is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the real-Serilog baseline (custom ILogEventSink + ILogEventEnricher keep using Serilog.Core/Serilog.Events). gotchas: Herald RenderMessage() does not quote string values (init vs "init") — a rendered-text difference, not a semantic/behavior change.

projects.notes: Advanced case — both boundaries now CLOSED in source (fixes on branch feat/four-project-migration, local commits only, unpublished). (1) LoggerConfiguration.Filter fluent integration shipped: .Filter.ByExcluding(string)/ByIncludingOnly(string) compile on the config chain (string-DSL extension in MMP.Herald.Serilog.Expressions) AND drop the event end-to-end. Fixing this also repaired a pre-existing bug: Build()'s JSON path silently discarded the in-memory filter slot (WithCustomFilter / WithFilterExpression / WithProjectionFilter) — now threaded through. (2) SECURITY fixed: Destructure.ByTransforming / Destructure.With redaction now applies on the NATIVE capture path (before any sink), so the ApiKey is stripped on WriteTo.Console()/File() — sink-independent, matching real Serilog. Covered surface = the ILogger interface + static Log facade (every migration call site). Documented residual: the concrete-typed Information<T1> overload on a native sink is not covered, but is unreachable via the interface/facade. migrated.runs=true reflects the branch code (test-proven); the after/ sample PackageReferences published 0.12.5 and reproduces faithfully only after publish.
gotchas: FIXED (security): destructuring redaction now holds on native sinks (WriteTo.Console/File) — applied at property capture before any sink. Regression suite REG-SERILOG-DESTRUCTURE-NATIVE-SINK (7 tests). Residual boundary (pinned by test): concrete-typed Information<T1> + native sink is uncovered, but unreachable through the Serilog ILogger interface or static Log facade, so not a migration leak.

FIXED: LoggerConfiguration.Filter fluent integration. .Filter.ByExcluding(string)/ByIncludingOnly(string) (string-DSL extension in MMP.Herald.Serilog.Expressions) compile on the chain and drop events end-to-end. Multiple .Filter calls AND-compose (Serilog semantics).

Pre-existing bug fixed in passing: QuickLogBuilder.Build() (JSON path) never threaded the in-memory _samplingFilter slot into the policy, so WithCustomFilter/WithFilterExpression/WithProjectionFilter were silently discarded. Now passed as additionalFilters (same pattern as enricher/eventProcessors) and AND-merged with JSON-declared filters.
